senses.gloss: (b. h.; יכל, cmp. כּוּל, כָּלַל, כִּלְכֵּל) (adj.) m., יְכוֹלָה f. capable, able to sustain, enduring;
(verb), impf. יוּכַל, to be capable, able; one can, may; it is possible.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>לארי יָכֹלְתִּי</he> … <he>איני י׳</he> I overpowered the lion, and I should not overpower the dog? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שר שלכם לא י׳ … ואתם יְכוֹלִים להם</he> your guardian angel could not stand against their father (Jacob), and (you think) you could master them?—<cite ref="J00358"><he>יְכוֹלְנִי</he></cite> = <he>י׳ אני</he> I can.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:1">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> top Ms. M. (ed. <he>יכול אני</he>); <cite ref="Niddah 64b:5">Nidd. 64ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 95a:16">Keth. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שי׳ לומר וכ׳</he> because he may plead &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 95a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>יְכוֹלָה היא שתאמר</he> she may plead.
<cite ref="Ketubot 43a:10">Ib. 43ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>י׳ הרב לומר וכ׳</he> the master may (has a right to) say to his slave &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 6a:2">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אין כל בריה י׳ לעמוד וכ׳</he> no creature could stand up (exist) before the demons.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1048:9">Yalk. Esth. 1048</cite> <he>שמא תוּכַל להשיאה וכ׳</he> canst thou give her in marriage to both of them?—
Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV לא יָכְלוּ להתודות וכ׳ they could not confess their sins with their mouth; a. v. fr.—Esp. יָכוֹל (= יכול אני לומר or י׳ אתה לומר) I (you) might think, argue, conclude.

Sabb. 64ᵃ י׳ שאני מרבה וכ׳ from the Bible text (Lev. XI, 32) I might infer that ropes and cords are included; Sifra Sh’mini Par. 6, ch. VIII; a. v. fr.—כִּבְיָכוֹל as though it were possible, as it were (ref. to an allegorical or anthropomorphous expression with reference to the Lord). Mekh. Bo, Pisḥa, s. 14 כל זמן … כ׳ שכינה עמהם whenever Israel is enslaved, the Divine Majesty, as it were, is with them in slavery. Ib. כ׳ אמרו ישראל וכ׳ the Israelites said, thou, as it were, hast redeemed thyself. Ib. B’shall., Shirah, s. 6 כ׳ כלפי מעלה as if referring to the Lord’s eye.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 79b:5">B. Kam. 79ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00971"><he>מַטָּה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Ch. <cite ref="J00363"><he>יְכִיל</he></cite>.
